title: L. Tarquinius Priscus
summary: Raleigh names L. Tarquinius Priscus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). L. Tarquinius Priscus, a new-come stranger, who got the Kingdome of Rome from the sonnes of Ancus, ouer whom he was Tutor. He is not Tarquinius Superbus, who stays on tarquin. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXVIII, §. V, sig. 377a
